_source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/image-generation and /generate-content/image-generation, checked 2026-10-28. Re-check when a call is rejected.
_notes: imageSize needs an uppercase K ('1K','2K','4K'); '512' has no K. Lowercase is rejected.
Not documented as supported (so never sent): mask/inpainting, transparent output, seed, negative prompt, steps, quality.
Every output carries a SynthID watermark.
Pixel dimensions per size are not tabulated in the docs: verify the downloaded file instead of trusting the requested size.

gemini_app._note: Web app (gemini.google.com): model chosen in the UI picker; aspect ratio and size come only from the prompt and are not guaranteed. On-page image is a ~1024px preview; 'Download full-sized image' gives the full file. Observed 2026-10-28: preview 1024x572 for 16:9 prompts.
